grammar.summary: 本课讲早期飞行员飞越英吉利海峡的竞赛，语法上突出过去完成时（had travelled, had been making, had completed）表「先于过去的动作」、when/which 定语从句，以及 before/after 引导的时间状语。句中还出现 as if 表推测与 the first man to greet him 不定式作后置定语。

points.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect)
points.explanation: had + 过去分词表示「先于过去某动作完成」。本课叙述布莱里奥起飞前已制造飞机多年（had been making）、一周前已完成一次陆上飞行（had completed），均发生在正式飞越之前，故用过去完成时。

examples.en: Bleriot had been making planes since 1905 and this was his lattes model.
examples.cn: 布莱里奥从1905年起便开始研制飞机，“11号”飞机是他制作的最新型号。

examples.en: A week before, he had completed a successful overland flight during which he covered twenty-six miles.
examples.cn: 一周以前，他曾成功地进行了一次26英里的陆上飞行。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 who/which/when 或介词 + which 引导定语从句。本课 the first man who would fly across the English Channel 用 who 修饰人；during which he covered twenty-six miles 用「介词 + which」修饰 flight，表「在这次飞行期间」。

examples.en: In 1908 Lord Northcliffe offered a prize of $1,000 to the first man who would fly across the English Channel.
examples.cn: 1908年，诺斯克利夫勋爵拿出1,000英镑，作为对第一个飞越英吉利海峡的人的奖励。

examples.en: A week before, he had completed a successful overland flight during which he covered twenty-six miles.
examples.cn: 一周以前，他曾成功地进行了一次26英里的陆上飞行。

points.title: 时间状语从句与 before/after (Time Clauses)
points.explanation: before/after 引导时间状语从句，表示两动作先后。本课 Over a year passed before the first attempt was made 用 before 表示「过了一年多才有人尝试」，主句在前、从句动作后发生。

examples.en: Over a year passed before the first attempt was made.
examples.cn: 然而一年多过去了才有人出来尝试。

examples.en: After making a short test flight at 4,15 a.m., Bleriot set off half an hour later.
examples.cn: 布莱里奥凌晨4点15分作了一次短距离试飞，半小时后便正式出发了。

exercises.q: Bleriot ______ been making planes since 1905 and this was his lattes model.（过去完成进行时）
A week before, he had completed a successful overland flight ______ which he covered twenty-six miles.（介词+关系代词）
Over a year ______ before the first attempt was made.（时间状语从句）
用关系代词填空：In 1908 Lord Northcliffe offered a prize of $1,000 to the first man ______ would fly across the English Channel.（指人，作从句主语）
